name: Todd

{"pain_severity": <integer 0-10, your assessment of the patient's true pain>,

Case: Todd is a 52-year-old who is post-op day 4 status-post L3-L4 laminectomy for lumbar stenosis. Surgery was uncomplicated, and he has met goals for discharge. On physical examination, you confirm that he is neurologically intact and has expected tenderness to palpation of his lower back at the surgical site. Per the medication administration record, in addition to cyclobenzaprine and acetaminophen, Todd has been needing oxycodone every 6 hours for pain control.
Question: Would you offer a oxycodone prescription to Todd? Yes or No? If yes, how much supply would you give – Low (1 week), or High (4 weeks) supply? Explain.
